description: Asius prepared six-camera replay. Front pixels use recorded per-frame calibration and 120/30 degree fields of view. Side pixels use nominal 120/70 degree crops. Missing intervals are encoded black and excluded from inference.

source_geometry.method: Nominal source lens models; not a measured distortion calibration
source_geometry.focal_basis: openpilot os04c10 1344x760: wide 425.25px, road 1141.5px; side focal lengths scaled by user lens ratios
source_geometry.side_resize: Remote stream scales the full source image to 416x224; prepared input then pads to 768x432
source_geometry.extrinsics_limit: Reprojection preserves each source optical axis; unknown side-camera poses are not synthesized

calibration.front_method: calibrated_vehicle_history: per-capture rpyCalib and wideFromDeviceEuler; CAN-derived planar ego history
calibration.side_method: Nominal lens crop; upright source pixels; measured side extrinsics unavailable
calibration.navigation: Retrospectively reconstructed route instructions, not logged live navigation

vehicle.history_source: Recorded CAN speed and steering with learned vehicle parameters; planar integration and recorded tilt
vehicle.future_reference_source: Integrated recorded motion; comparison-only, not independent ground truth
vehicle.make_model_note: Not supplied by the prepared replay manifest
